d: Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Under limited supervision, normally receives little instruction on routine contract administration, general instructions on new project assignments.
Manages and administers construction contracts for high-rise and complex projects, ensuring compliance with contractual terms, conditions, and regulatory requirements.
Operates and manages project management information systems, performs tasks such as storing contract data, tracking milestones, managing change orders, and generating compliance reports.
Reviews contract documentation, technical specifications, and project schedules from project teams regarding deliverables, timelines, budget allocations, and performance metrics.
Researches contractual obligations, identifies potential risks and disputes, and analyzes contract terms to ensure alignment with project scope and organizational standards.
Records contract amendments, verifies accuracy of contractual data, and prepares contract summaries, risk assessments, and performance reports for stakeholder review.
An experienced professional with full understanding of construction contract management and high-rise project delivery.
Works on problems of diverse scope across multiple concurrent projects and stakeholder groups.
q: Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in contract management and administration within the construction industry
Proven background in Project Management Consultancy (PMC) with demonstrated expertise in Giga or Mega project delivery
Extensive experience managing construction contracts for high-rise and complex projects
Advanced proficiency with project management information systems and contract administration software
Strong knowledge of contractual obligations, risk identification, and dispute resolution methodologies
Demonstrated ability to review and analyze complex contract documentation, technical specifications, and project schedules
Experience preparing contract summaries, risk assessments, and performance reports for senior stakeholders
Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects across diverse stakeholder groups
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field
Professional certifications such as PMP, DPLP, or equivalent contract management credentials
Experience with large-scale infrastructure or commercial development projects
Knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements and industry standards
Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills
Experience with change order management and contract amendment documentation
